replies.author: cinammoncroc000
replies.body:
I've never tried Heavy, since I'm only level 30 ;_;
Medic isn't bad, it's good if you're more defensive.
Scout is just annoying and it can become brutal if you use it right (quick strafing and stuffs.)
Sniper is the best class with a bow and dangerous if you have the aim.
Haven't tried Engineer... :T

I'd say Scout is my favorite. :)
